TITLE: 滴天髓闡微 (滴天髓阐微)
BASE_TEXT_AUTHOR: 京圖 (attributed, Song); 原注 traditionally attributed to 劉基 — attribution contested
ERA: base text Song (attributed); commentary c. 1848 (清 道光)
ACCESS_LOCATION: https://www.guwendao.net/guwen/book_74c064ea85bf.aspx (64-entry index: 序第一 + 上篇 34 + 下篇 29); per-chapter bookv_<hash>.aspx
ACCESS_NOTE: Host oss.guwendao.net returns HTTP 404; use www.guwendao.net or m.guwendao.net with identical paths. gushiwen.cn book-index returns 500 but its per-chapter pages resolve. NOTE: guwendao.net and gushiwen.cn serve the SAME backend text (footer string differs only), so a cross-fetch proves non-truncation but is NOT an independent edition witness.
CHAPTER_NUMBERING_CORRECTION: This edition's numbering differs from the numbering assumed during V1. Verified against the served index: 形象第十一, 方局第十二, 八格第十三, 官杀第二十二, 伤官第二十三, 剛柔第二十八, 顺逆第二十九 (all 上篇); 反局第五十二 (下篇). The 第四十四/第四十五 slots are 奋郁 and 恩怨, NOT 形象/方局. All SOURCE_LOCATION fields in discovery-cases.json use the numbering AS SERVED.
SCRIPT: SIMPLIFIED, with sporadic traditional glyphs left in place (陰, 陽, 煞). Transcribed verbatim as printed; not converted.
RELIABILITY_NOTES: Faithful in substance but carries OCR/typesetting corruption. Observed: 已/己, 任/壬, 仁/仕, 动/却, 戌/戊 substitutions; duplicated 余气 definition; run-together and out-of-order luck pillars; internal contradiction between the 衰旺 任氏曰 list (土旺极者而似水) and its own Example 10 (土旺极者，似金也). All transcribed as printed and flagged TRANSCRIPTION_UNCERTAIN rather than corrected.
KNOWN_SCHOOL_BIAS: 滴天髓 lineage; whole-chart 氣勢 reading. Explicitly hostile to 俗論 (formulaic reading) — constructs examples specifically to refute mechanical rules, which makes it unusually rich in counterexamples.
SEX_MARKERS: NONE anywhere in the chapters surveyed. SEX_IF_GIVEN = NOT_STATED throughout; never inferred.
SURVEY_VS_EXTRACTION_NOTE: 22 chapters surveyed; 226 worked charts located; 131 records extracted into the corpus. Where `extracted` < `charts`, the shortfall is DELIBERATE SELECTION under §5's 'quality beats count', not a retrieval failure: priority went to charts carrying explicit strength/capacity vocabulary, all matched pairs, all counterexamples, and every 從/假從/從兒 case. The unextracted remainder is available for S2 at the URLs recorded here and was not discarded.
